questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. We must plant and ______ at least one tree every year.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

We must plant and ______ at least one tree every year.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'nurture'.

Key Points  

  • Let's take a look at the word 'tree', the sentence is talking about planting and caring for trees.
  • Now, let's take a look at the meaning of the given options:
    • assemble: to come or bring together; collect or congregate.
      • Example: There wasn't even a convenient place for students to assemble between classes.
    • utilise: make practical and effective use of.
      • Example: Guests can utilise the host of complimentary land and water sports facilities.
    • nurture: care for and encourage the growth or development of.
      • Example: The modern conservatory is not an environment for nurturing plants.
    • abolish: formally put an end to (a system, practice, or institution).
      • Example: The following year Parliament voted to abolish the death penalty for murder.
  • In the blank, we need a word which can represent the word 'care' thus, 'nurture' is the right fit for the blank.
  • Thus, from above, it is clear that the correct answer is option 13.

Correct sentence: We must plant and nurture at least one tree every year.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. Smoking is ____ to health.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Smoking is ____ to health.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. injurious.

Explanation-

Let us look at the sentence carefully and analyze it. The subject of this sentence is 'smoking' and we need an appropriate adjective for smoking that will fit in the blank given above, let's have a look at all the given options. 

  • Tedious:  tiresome because of length or dullness: BORING
  • Serious: thoughtful or subdued in appearance or manner: SOBER
  • Anxious: characterized by extreme uneasiness of mind or brooding fear about some contingency: WORRIED
  • Injurious: inflicting or tending to inflict injury: DETRIMENTAL

​
Now after going through the sentence and options, we can easily comprehend that smoking cannot be tedious serious and anxious, the only proper adjective that will fit in the given blank is 'injurious' as smoking causes cancer hence it is injurious to health.

Correct sentence- ​Smoking is injurious to health.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Both the criminals were cruel and ________.

  • The word "brutal" means savagely violent or inhumanely cruel. (क्रूर)

​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.

  • Diligent (परिश्रमी): Showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties.

questions.question: Direction: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. All the ______ candidates who take the test will receive scorecards
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

All the ______ candidates who take the test will receive scorecards
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'eligible'.

Key Points

  • Let's explore the options:
    • Entitled​: feeling that you have the right to do or have what you want without having to work for it or deserve it, just because of who you are (यह महसूस करना कि आपको उसके लिए काम करने या उसके लायक होने के बिना वह करने का अधिकार है या जो आप चाहते हैं, सिर्फ इसलिए कि आप कौन हैं)
    • Illegible: (of writing or print) impossible or almost impossible to read because of being very untidy or not clear ((लिखने या छापने का) बहुत गन्दा या स्पष्ट न होने के कारण पढ़ना असंभव या लगभग असंभव है)
    • Eligible​: having the necessary qualities or satisfying the necessary conditions (आवश्यक गुण होना या आवश्यक शर्तों को पूरा करना)
    • Legible: Legible writing or print can be read easily (सुपाठ्य लेखन या प्रिंट आसानी से पढ़ा जा सकता है)
  • According to the above meanings 'eligible' will be used to make the sentence meaningful.
  • Thus, option 3 will be the correct answer.

 

Hence, the correct sentence is: All the eligible candidates who take the test will receive scorecards.

questions.question: Fill in the blank with an appropriate option. Participants were ______ a meal of steak and French fries under dim light.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The students of class 7 gave their teacher a gift, which was ________ to her.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The students of class 7 gave their teacher a gift, which was ________ to her.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Surprising.
 
Key Points
  • The sentence indicates that the gift given by the students was unexpected to the teacher.
  • The word "surprising" (आश्‍चर्यजनक) means causing surprise or wonder, which fits the context of the gift being unexpected or not anticipated by the teacher.
  • The words "revealing," "shocking," and "confusing" do not fit as well in this context because they convey different meanings that are not implied by the sentence.
  • Understanding the meaning of "surprising" in the context of the sentence helps to clarify that the gift was unexpected and caused a sense of surprise for the teacher.
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.
 
Correct Answer: The students of class 7 gave their teacher a gift, which was surprising to her.
 
Additional Information
  • Revealing means making something known or visible (प्रकट करना).
  • Shocking means causing intense surprise, disgust, or horror (चौंकाने वाला).
  • Confusing means causing bewilderment or perplexity (उलझन में डालने वाला).

questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

If you don't have a lump sum to ______ in a fixed deposit, you can surely opt for a long-term recurring deposit.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'invest'.
 
Key Points
  • The word "invest" means to allocate money in the expectation of some benefit in the future. (निवेश करना)
  • In the context of financial products like fixed deposits, "invest" is the most appropriate term.
  • The other options: "gather," "publish," and "draw" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.

Complete Sentence: If you don't have a lump sum to invest in a fixed deposit, you can surely opt for a long-term recurring deposit.

Additional Information
  • Gather (इकट्ठा करना): means to collect.
  • Publish (प्रकाशित करना): means to make content publicly known.
  • Draw (खींचना): means to pull or drag.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate collocating word to fill in the blank. The girl has ________ chances of winning the match.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate collocating word to fill in the blank.

The girl has ________ chances of winning the match.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'high.'

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:
    Word Meaning
    bountiful large in amount. (प्रचुर)
    high greater than the usual level or amount. (उच्च संभावना)
    light not heavy. (हलका)
    hefty large and heavy. (बड़ा और भारी)
  • According to the context of the sentence the word "chances" is often used with the adjective "high" to denote a strong possibility of something happening, which is appropriate to describe the chances of winning a match.
  • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "high."
  • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
  • Another example:
    • There seemed to be a high probability of success.
 

Complete Sentence: The girl has high chances of winning the match.

Additional Information

  • A collocation is two or more words that often go together. These combinations just sound "right" to native English speakers, who use them all the time.
    • Examples: A quick meal, a quick shower, completely satisfied etc.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. To _______ the ticket, Amith had to visit the travel agency many times.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

To _______ the ticket, Amith had to visit the travel agency many times.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'confirm'.
 
Key Points
  • The word "confirm" means to establish the truth or correctness of something. (पुष्टि करना)
  • In the context of the sentence, Amit had to visit the travel agency many times to verify or establish the validity of the ticket.

​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.

Complete Sentence: To confirm the ticket, Amith had to visit the travel agency many times.

Additional Information
  • Contract (अनुबंध): means a written or spoken agreement, especially one concerning employment, sales, or tenancy, that is intended to be enforceable by law.
  • Conform (अनुरूप होना): means to comply with rules, standards, or laws.
  • Convention (सम्मेलन): means a large meeting or conference, especially of members of a political party or a particular profession.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. These days you can transfer money _______ from one account to another.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

These days you can transfer money _______ from one account to another.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'instantly'.

Key Points

  • The word 'instantly' means 'at once; immediately.'
    • For example, With e-mail, you can send a message across the world almost instantly.
  • According to the given context, the word 'instantly' fits correctly as money can be transferred immediately these days. 
  • Therefore, option 3 is the correct answer. 


Complete Sentence: These days you can transfer money instantly from one account to another.

Hinglish

  • शब्द 'instantly' का अर्थ है 'एक बार में; तुरंत।'
    • उदाहरण के लिए, With e-mail, you can send a message across the world almost instantly.
  • दिए गए संदर्भ के अनुसार, 'instantly' शब्द सही ढंग से फिट बैठता है क्योंकि इन दिनों पैसा तुरंत स्थानांतरित किया जा सकता है।
  • अतः विकल्प 3 सही उत्तर है।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Bhanu, the security guard, asks everyone entering my building to show their ________ card.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Bhanu, the security guard, asks everyone entering my building to show their ________ card.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 1.

Key Points

  • The word "identity" means the fact of being who or what a person or thing is. (पहचान)
    • Example: She showed her identity card at the entrance.
  • The context tells us that Bhanu, the security guard, requests that everyone entering the building show their ID card.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Place (स्थान): A particular position or point in space.
    • Example: This is the place where we first met.
  • Self (स्वयं): A person's essential being that distinguishes them from others.
    • Example: She is always true to her self.
  • Name (नाम): A word or set of words by which a person or thing is known.
    • Example: His name is well-known in the community.

questions.question: Based on the context of the given sentence, select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank. After spending hours working non-stop on the project, the team decided to ________ and go home.
questions.questionHtml:
Based on the context of the given sentence, select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

After spending hours working non-stop on the project, the team decided to ________ and go home.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'call it a day'.
 
Key Points
  • The idiom "call it a day" means to stop working on something, typically after a long period of work. (काम खत्म करना)
  • After spending hours working non-stop on the project, it is appropriate for the team to decide to stop for the day.
  • The other options: "run out of steam," "take it easy," and "hit the books" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.

Complete Sentence: After spending hours working non-stop on the project, the team decided to call it a day and go home.

Additional Information
  • Run out of steam: means to lose energy or enthusiasm.
  • Take it easy: means to relax and not work hard.
  • Hit the books: means to start studying.

questions.question: Fill in the blank with an appropriate option. The makers of sports drinks spend tens to hundreds of millions of dollars ______ their products each year.
questions.questionHtml:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

The makers of sports drinks spend tens to hundreds of millions of dollars ______ their products each year.
questions.solution: Advertising is the correct answer. It refers to the act of promoting a product or service through various media channels such as television, radio, print, and digital platforms. In the context of sports drinks, advertising is used to create brand awareness, highlight the benefits of the product, and persuade consumers to purchase it. For example, Gatorade, a popular sports drink brand, spends millions of dollars on advertising campaigns featuring famous athletes such as Serena Williams and Michael Jordan to promote their products.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The perfume she uses has a strong ______.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The perfume she uses has a strong ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: scent.

Key Points

  • 'The perfume she uses has a strong ______.', the missing word must refer to the smell or aroma which is produced by the perfume.
  • The correct English word for this context is 'scent'. ("सुगन्ध" or "खुशबू")
    • Example: The floral scent of her perfume filled the entire room.

Therefore, the correct answer is: 'scent'.

Additional Information

  • sent: It is the past and past participle of the verb 'send' which in Hindi means (भेजा हुआ)
  • scend: It is a nautical term meaning the upward movement of a ship on a wave. (हलचल)
  • cent: It is a unit of currency in many countries. (सेंट)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. It is being asked why there has been no _________ taken yet.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
It is being asked why there has been no _________ taken yet.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'action'.
 
Key Points
  • The sentence expresses a concern or query regarding the absence of any steps or measures taken.
  • The noun "action" appropriately fits the context, meaning a measure or step initiated to address a situation. (कार्यवाही)
  • The phrase "no action taken" is a commonly used expression in formal and official communication.
  • Other options do not logically fit:
    • Distribution: Refers to handing out something – not relevant here.
    • Simplification: Means making something simpler – contextually incorrect.
    • Attribution: Means assigning a cause or source – grammatically and contextually unsuitable.

​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1'.

Complete Sentence: It is being asked why there has been no action taken yet.

Additional Information
  • Common usage: "No action has been taken," "Immediate action is required," etc.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. The speaker requested the audience to pay ________.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. There was a huge demand for entry tickets at the ________.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

There was a huge demand for entry tickets at the ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'venue.'

Key Points 

  • Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:
    Word Meaning
    venom a poisonous liquid that some snakes, insects, etc. produce and can put into another animal's body by biting or stinging. (एक जहरीला तरल जो कुछ सांप, कीड़े आदि पैदा करते हैं और काटकर या डंक मारकर दूसरे जानवर के शरीर में डाल सकते हैं)
    vent a small opening that allows air, smoke, or gas to enter or leave a closed space. (एक छोटा उद्घाटन जो हवा, धुएं या गैस को एक बंद स्थान में प्रवेश करने या छोड़ने की अनुमति देता है)
    venue the place where a public event or meeting happens. (वह स्थान जहाँ कोई सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रम या बैठक होती है)
    venture a new activity, usually in business, that involves risk or uncertainty. (एक नई गतिविधि, आमतौर पर व्यवसाय में, जिसमें जोखिम या अनिश्चितता शामिल होती है)
  • The context of the sentence is that the entry tickets were in high demand of the place of the public event.
  • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "venue."
  • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.
  • Another example:
    •  The venue for the FIFA World Cup 2022 is Qatar.
 

Complete Sentence: There was a huge demand for entry tickets at the venue.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. The sales team ______ the engineers for the organization’s failure to bag the mega deal.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. When Mr. Bhanot was told a few years back that he needed to lose _____ or face health problems, he transformed his life with the _____ of a personal trainer.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

When Mr. Bhanot was told a few years back that he needed to lose _____ or face health problems, he transformed his life with the _____ of a personal trainer.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 1.

Key Points

  • The word "weight" refers to a measure of how heavy something is. It is often used in the context of body weight or physical mass. (वजन)
    • Example: She is trying to lose weight by following a healthy diet and exercising regularly.
  • The word "help" means providing assistance or support to someone in need. (मदद)
    • Example: The teacher offered help to the students struggling with their assignments.
  • In the given sentence, "weight" and "help" are the most appropriate choices as they align with the idea of losing physical mass and transforming one's life with the assistance of a personal trainer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Option 2: Money, Instructions
    • Money (पैसा): Refers to currency or a medium of exchange.
      • Example: She saved money to buy a new car.
    • Instructions (निर्देश): Refers to detailed information or directions on how something should be done.
      • Example: The manual provided clear instructions to assemble the furniture.
  • Option 3: Wait, Assistance
    • Wait (प्रतीक्षा): Refers to the act of staying in one place until something happens.
      • Example: We had to wait for the bus to arrive.
    • Assistance (सहायता): Refers to help or support provided to someone.
      • Example: The manager offered assistance to the new employee.
  • Option 4: Patience, Guidance
    • Patience (धैर्य): Refers to the ability to remain calm and not get irritated while waiting.
      • Example: He showed great patience while waiting for his turn.
    • Guidance (मार्गदर्शन): Refers to advice or instructions provided to help someone.
      • Example: The mentor's guidance helped her achieve her goals.

Example: She could not conceive of a world without music.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. After suffering so many losses, the company is about to go _____.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

After suffering so many losses, the company is about to go _____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1' i.e. 'Bankrupt'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is: 'Bankrupt'
  • "Bankrupt" is the correct choice because it refers to the state of being insolvent, or unable to pay debts, which is a common consequence for a company that has suffered many losses.
  • It's contextually appropriate and makes sense given the information in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: 'After suffering so many losses, the company is about to go bankrupt.

Additional Information

  • "Silent" could metaphorically mean the company is closing or ceasing operations, but it's not the most precise term for describing a company's financial state after heavy losses.
  • "Cynical" is an adjective typically used to describe a person's attitude or outlook, not a company's financial state. It's not contextually suitable here.
  • "Awry" means that something is going wrong or is off track. While it could loosely apply to a company in trouble, it doesn't convey the financial distress implied in the sentence as accurately as "bankrupt" does.

questions.question: Directions: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank in the given sentence. Today's ______ are only interested in watching movies with the stories they can relate to the cinema.

Directions: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank in the given sentence.

Today's ______ are only interested in watching movies with the stories they can relate to the cinema.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "audiences".

Key Points

  • Let us explore the given options:
    • 'Personalities' means the lively, engaging qualities.
    • 'Politics' means the activities associated with the governance of a country or area.
    • 'Accountants' means people whose job is to keep, inspect, and analyse financial accounts.
    • 'Audiences' means the assembled spectators or listeners at a public event such as a play, film, concert, or meeting.

Complete Sentence: Today's audiences are only interested in watching movies with the stories they can relate to the cinema.
